# Fictional checker test document

## TC-001: Booking administration
Requirements: REQ-001, REQ-002
Given: A visitor has a booking and another slot is available.
When: The visitor cancels the booking and returns to slot selection.
Then: A cancellation reference appears and the available slot is shown.

## TC-002: Referral
Requirements: REQ-003
Given: A new referral is ready to submit.
When: The referral is submitted.
Then: Its status is pending.
